title: The lost dog
text:
It was a cold Sunday morning in January. Ola went for a walk in the park with her dog, Burek. Burek loved the snow. He ran and jumped and played with other dogs. Then, suddenly, he saw a cat and ran after it. In a few seconds he was gone.

Ola called and called, but Burek didn't come back. She looked for him everywhere – near the lake, behind the trees, in the playground. After two hours she went home and cried. Her brother made some posters with Burek's photo and her phone number, and they put them on trees and in shops.

In the evening, the phone rang. It was an old man from the next street. "I think I've got your dog," he said. "He's in my kitchen. He's eating my sausages!" Ola ran to his house. Burek was there, happy and warm, next to the old man's cat. The two animals were friends now!

Ola thanked the man and brought him a cake the next day. Now they often go for walks together.
